name: rqeim-cloud
description: Manage the applications on your Rqeim Cloud account: environments, previews, logs, domains, health and backups.

interface.longDescription:
Rqeim Cloud runs Docker applications from a Git repository. This plugin connects an assistant to a Rqeim Cloud account so it can read what is deployed, change code in a sandboxed copy of a project, preview it, and publish it after the person agrees.

It also reads what is wrong: failed deploys, machines that do not start, logs, disk pressure, stale backups and broken addresses.
defaultPrompt: What is broken in my Rqeim Cloud projects?
